risk_note: RV1 (apps/h5/src/components/base). H5 base components: EmptyState, ErrorState, Skeleton, Toast, Dialog, Sheet on design tokens (no literal colours, no CJK in source); dialog structure and focus (title focus, Tab cycle, Esc / backdrop, layer stack, focus return after the commit once the background leaves inert); Sheet title 22px per the design board. Rule tests by Codex (two writes, red first in the container, jsdom and browser screenshots), implementation by Opus 5.5 (three rounds). Container browser run 15/15 and screenshots compared with StateLoadFailed / LoginAgreeConfirm / ProductAuthSheet (differences logged for the design session). Written by hand.

Output adopted although codex-run flagged a branch position change caused by the orchestrator creating another task worktree in the same clone (review is read-only)
